description: This file implements an in-memory notes API class for managing Note objects, including storing, updating, and fetching notes based on their update times.

classes.name: InMemoryNotesApi
classes.description: A class that implements the NotesApi interface, providing in-memory storage and retrieval of Note objects.

methods.name: pushNotes
methods.description: Stores a list of notes, updating existing ones if they are newer or adding new entries.

methods.name: fetchNotesUpdatedSince
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notes that have been updated since a specified timestamp, sorted by update time descending.
